fp_finding: Every false positive carries a counted determinant, and the determinants with ZERO true-R carriers contribute only false positives in this cohort. That is the MIRROR of the gentamicin `rmt` case: there a determinant the rule could not SEE produced false negatives; here a determinant the rule COUNTS produces false positives. Changing what the rule counts would edit the sha256-pinned frozen surface and retire the active prospective lock, so it is a USER AUTHORITY call and is deliberately NOT made here.
fp_attribution: NOT A RULE BUG -- an UPSTREAM catalog assertion the rule faithfully propagates. Verified on GCA_004836905.1: gyrA_P104S is the SOLE counted determinant (n_determinants=1, counter='qrdr_point', threshold=1), and AMRFinderPlus itself files it as Class=QUINOLONE / Subclass=QUINOLONE named 'Campylobacter quinolone resistant GyrA'. The frozen rule counts QUINOLONE-class gyrA point mutations, so it is behaving exactly as specified; the resistance-conferring claim for P104S originates in AMRFinder's catalog. A fix therefore belongs upstream, or in an L2 doubt flag, not in the counting logic.

honest_limits: `determinants` are the hits the FROZEN rule COUNTS for this drug, not everything AMRFinder reported. An FN listed as determinant-free may still carry an uncounted element, which is precisely the distinction between a declared blind spot and a catalog gap -- so a determinant-free FN bounds the rule's input, it does not prove the genome is bare.
Labels are portal MIC run through this repo's STRICT tiers; a mislabelled isolate presents as an FN and nothing here can separate that from a genotype miss.
Campylobacter cipro R is overwhelmingly gyrA_T86I, so bucket determinant frequencies are dominated by one substitution and are not a broad coverage census.
The cohort is 96.4% one country (see the cell artifact's source_concentration verdict), so an absent determinant family may be absent from the COHORT rather than rare in the world.
A zero-true-R determinant is reported with its Wilson CI because the carrier counts are SMALL; 0 of 6 is suggestive and is NOT a demonstration that the substitution is benign.
PPV here is MARGINAL per determinant, not causal: a carrier may hold several determinants, so credit is not attributable to one symbol from these counts alone.
Not clonality-corrected, so carriers of one determinant may be a handful of clones.
